msg.sender selects the account whose balance is destroyed by _burn

recipient parameter is forwarded to the external transfer
amount parameter is forwarded to the external transfer
onlyOwner modifier guards the rescueTokens privileged function
_owner state variable is compared against the caller inside onlyOwner
msg.sender is checked against _owner for privileged calls
onlyOwner obtains the caller identity through _msgSender()
_msgSender returns msg.sender directly
constructor mints the initial token supply

supply_ local variable is passed into _mint
constructor mints the entire supply to msg.sender

spender parameter is only consumed by approve/_approve allowance logic
